entities.summary: "Milkshake Man" is a song by Australian singer and songwriter Go-Jo. It was written by Go-Jo alongside Amy Sheppard, George Sheppard, and Jason Bovino. The song was released on 25 February 2025 and represented Australia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025. It entered the charts in Sweden, Lithuania, and Iceland.
